reuse.why: Introduces a shared category selection and income check, but setAllCategoriesAverage re-inlines getCategoryAverage plus the sign flip that setNMonthAvg already provides, and copyPreviousMonth does not use the new selection.

duplication.why: Collapsing the 3/6/12-month actions into one helper removes copies, but the average-and-negate logic of setNMonthAvg is duplicated and copyPreviousMonth keeps its own hidden/template filter.

placement.why: Selection and actions stay in server/budget/actions.ts and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions; the goal_def column added to getBudgetData is needed for copyPreviousMonth, and the averaging refactor is a reasonable side-cleanup.

maintainability.why: Most actions share one selection function, but copyPreviousMonth follows a separate path that lacks the #fixed and includeHiddenCategories rules, so the exclusion rule still has two homes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth filters hidden/group-hidden/goal_def inline over getBudgetData instead of using getMonthActionCategories; setAllCategoriesAverage bypasses setNMonthAvg.

disguised_duplication.where: setAllCategoriesAverage reshapes setNMonthAvg's getCategoryAverage + 'is_income === 0 -> negate' body inline; copyPreviousMonth's if-chain restates the SQL WHERE of getMonthActionCategories.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains includeHiddenCategories; copyPreviousMonth re-implements the selection rather than calling it.
